properties.description: Pins the class behind fact:root-cause-a-claims-step-count-sums-its-lines-so-a-shared-step-counts-twice-2026-10-18 over the MCP surface. On proof trial rung 2 and rung 1, imported from their committed fixtures, for EVERY concluded claim: proof_status.total_steps equals the distinct Inferences reachable below it through its holding lines (computed from the export's own CONCLUDES and PREMISE_OF edges), never exceeds the design's Inference count, and confirmed_steps and unconfirmed_steps split that same set. Named: rung 2's uniqueness reads 40 (was 47) and its theorem 41; rung 1's theorem reads at most 25 (21; was 26). A hand-built claim with two lines sharing a step counts it once, and is proven only when one line's own steps, the shared one included, are all confirmed.
